title: Overflight of salvage operation following helicopter crash in Sabine Pass, Texas
description:
HOUSTON - In this video by the U.S. Coast Guard, an Air Station Houston MH-65 rescue helicopter crew provides overflight coverage during a salvage operation, 2-miles off the coast of Sabine Pass, Texas, Friday, Dec. 12, 2008.

The salvage operation follows the crash of a civilian helicopter, which was reported to the Coast Guard at 9:47 a.m., Thursday, Dec. 11, 2008.

Air Station Houston and Air Station Corpus Christi, Station Sabine and the cutter Heron have all been assisting in this search and rescue effort.

(U.S. Coast Guard video/Petty Officer 3rd Class Jason Spaeth)
